cases.name: New desk starts real tsh and runs its typed pipe
counter replaces tsh in the same pane and accepts an action
Native terminal accepts keyboard input and browser paste
Ctrl-C returns to the shell and one Escape reaches native input
Returning through tsh keeps the same terminal process and output
Hidden counter advances and finishes while every browser is closed
Fresh attach and reload preserve saved count, hidden panes and live shell
Node crash resumes hidden work to its original target; browser reconnects and terminal gets a new shell
Origin, startup token, malformed input, unknown action and wrong program are refused

scope: Local tsh-first GUI, durable counter and pane records, ephemeral native Terminal. No provider or cloud run.

plantedBreak.change: serve only current pane kind, ignore other started programs
